author: Home Repair Tutor
description:
Consejos para nivelación con mortero usando Schluter KERDI-BOARD…muchas gracias a Schluter por proporcionar los materiales para este proyecto. 

I’m using Schluter ALL-SET to wet shim the studs. This helps me make the KERDI-BOARD panel plumb, which is important the tile shower walls. Many thanks to Schluter for sending materials for this project. 

#shorts #schlutersystems #tileshower #brandpartner
